contract: API FlatScanObservationTracker(identity, range_min_m, range_max_m).observe(payload, *, read_at_sim_time_s, read_at_physics_frame, timeline_playing, phase)->JSON-safe dict. identity는run_id/scenario_id/robot_id/side/prim_path/topic/frame_id/actual_profile_sha256의고정mapping. 입력payload키timeStamp,numCols,numRows,linearDepthData는설치실제flat-scan출력. depth는rootwrapper가flatten해주는float iterable(NumPy scalars포함가능).

실제양수finite native timeStamp와비어있지않은buffer만고유관측후보. timestamp==last면duplicate,index증가안함; 감소면regressed/invalid로보존하고기존maxstamp/index변경안함. stamp0/missing/nonfinite/empty는warmup또는invalid로보존. read_at_time/frame증가만으로새scan번호만들지말것. unique_observation_index는이observer가읽은서로다른native timestamps수이며GMO/hardwareframe아님.

identity필드복사와충돌방지,run/robot/name/topic새identity를기존tracker에조용히섞지않음. range bounds/reader context는유한값,frame정수,b bool구분. Payload malformed에서루프전체죽이기보다error관측을반환하되constructor/readercontext오류는ValueError허용. actual numCols/numRows와buffer size불일치는상태에남김.
